transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because I think the people on the environmental modeling contract have been tracking my revisions and putting errors into the datasets. It makes it look like I can’t lead the work. My wife and the junior analysts say it’s just version-control mistakes, but I don’t think that explains it.
Have you ever heard voices, sounds, or murmurs when no one else was around?
No, I haven’t noticed voices or sounds like that when I’m alone.
How has your mood been feeling recently—have you been feeling down or depressed?
I’m not sure I’d call it depressed. I’ve been frustrated and on edge about the work situation, but I don’t really think of myself as feeling down.
How long have you felt that people have been altering your data to undermine you?
About two months now. That’s when I started becoming certain the revisions were being tracked and errors were being put into the data.
Have you ever felt like your thoughts were being controlled or put into your mind by an outside force?
No, I haven’t felt like an outside force was putting thoughts in my mind or controlling them.
Have you had any new medical problems or physical illnesses recently?
No, I haven’t noticed any new physical illnesses or medical problems recently.
Have you ever seen things that other people couldn't see?
No, I haven’t seen things that other people couldn’t see.
Have you ever felt that other people can read your mind or hear your thoughts?
No, I haven’t noticed other people being able to read my mind or hear my thoughts.
When this all started about two months ago, did these concerns develop suddenly over a few days, or did they build up gradually?
It’s been there for about two months—the feeling that people on the project are tracking my revisions and planting errors.
From the very first time you suspected something was wrong until you became fully convinced, did that change happen within a couple of weeks, or did it develop more slowly over a longer period?
It developed over about two months. I became convinced as it kept going on.
